build_task_template: build a PHYRE task template with a ball, horizontal bar with hole, and wall target using creator_lib
create_dynamic_ball: create a dynamic ball object in the PHYRE scene with a specified scale and position
add_static_bar: add a static bar to the PHYRE scene with configurable scale, angle, and position
update_task_relationships: update the PHYRE task to define a TOUCHING relationship between the ball and a wall
skip_template_params: skip invalid template parameter combinations by raising creator_lib.SkipTemplateParams when hole_right exceeds bounds
